clip.headline: Pirates Finish 12-2 and Unbeaten in League Play as Portal Exits Begin
clip.dek: East Carolina ends the year ranked No. 16 despite back-to-back losses, and four players have already entered the transfer portal.

posts.name: Purple Gold Pete
posts.text: 12-2. 8-0 in conference. Ranked 16. At ECU. Two losses at the end don't erase that and I won't let anyone tell me otherwise. In Pirate_flag we trust. ☠️

posts.name: Linda Harrelson Moye
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987 and I have seen some bad years. This is NOT one of them. Twelve wins! Went 8-0 in the league! I'll take the Memphis game and the bowl as lessons, not disasters. See y'all in the parking lot in September. Bring the good tailgate chairs, the old ones finally gave out. 💜💛

posts.name: Dowdy_Down_Low
posts.thread: Memphis 44-14... exposed or just a bad day?
posts.text: Not trying to be negative after a 12-win year, but we gave up 44 to Memphis and then lost a 24-21 bowl to Old Dominion. That's two straight where we looked a step slow. 63 overall is what it is. Are we a 12-win team or a team that got to 12 wins?

posts.name: Greenville Gabe
posts.text: Knighten, Favorite, Brake and one more in the portal. Wish those guys nothing but the best, but the depth chart is about to look different. Pirate_flag has work to do. Not panicking. Mildly nervous. Mostly eating a biscuit.

posts.name: Tailgate Tina
posts.text: Made this for next season already. Offseason is long, don't @ me 😤

posts.name: Monarch Mike
posts.text: Hey ECU fans, I know 12-2 feels great, but just remember who beat you in the bowl. 24-21. Enjoy the offseason, Pirates. 😘

posts.name: BuriedOnTheDepthChart
posts.thread: J.Smith passes on the portal, stays at ECU. Good or bad?
posts.text: Dude was on Portal Watch and just stayed. Respect. Still stuck behind guys on the depth chart, but with Knighten and the others leaving, maybe this is his shot. Pirate_flag gets some breathing room. I like it.

posts.name: Brenda B.
posts.text: Still not mad enough about the 12-2 season to skip it, but $9 for a hot dog and a Coke is a crime. I'm buying a boat with what I spent last year.

posts.name: Randy Whitford
posts.text: Recruiting class ranked 69th is a little bit of a worry for a guy like me, but this staff just won 12 games with a 2.5-star program. They've earned some trust. We recruit them, we develop them, we hit the portal smart. Fine by me. Go Pirates.

posts.name: Pirate Flag Truther
posts.text: Remember when a 12-win season would've made the entire fan base cry happy tears? Now we're mad about the last two games. Touch grass and enjoy the best season in a while. Pirate_flag has earned a statue. 🏴‍☠️

posts.name: PeeDeePirate
posts.text: We went 12-2 and got to No. 16. Let's be real: can we repeat that with four guys gone, a 69th ranked class, and a 63 overall? I think 10 wins is the floor if the portal goes OK. Anything over that is a bonus. Thoughts?

posts.name: Cap'n Dale
posts.text: Found this in my phone. Bowl day. Still stings, but I'm back in for next year. 24-21 is a one-possession game, come on. We'll get 'em.

clip.headline: Perfect Season, Quiet Portal: Buckeyes Lose Five, Keep the Rest
clip.dek: Ohio State closed 16-0 as national champions, and the only thing shaking in Columbus is the transfer portal.

posts.name: Scarlet Sam
posts.text: 16-0. National champs. Beat Nebraska 35-17 in the title game. Tuddy_roosevelt can run this program until I die and I'll still ask for more. WE ARE SO BACK (we never left)

posts.name: Dale Hutchinson
posts.text: Season tickets since 1987 and I have NEVER seen a team go 16-0 and win it all. Went to the title game, cried in the parking lot, cried in the stadium, cried at the Wendy's after. My wife says I need to calm down. I told her I'm calm. Go Bucks. Trust the process, Coach Tuddy!

posts.name: Brutus Brianna
posts.text: Framing this one. Title game. 35-17 over No. 2 Nebraska. Don't talk to me, I'm busy being happy.

posts.name: BuckeyeBrian_74
posts.thread: PORTAL THREAD: Who left, who stayed, who's about to lose it
posts.text: Lost Coffey, Timmons, Dre Quinn and two more. Stings. BUT Bing, Gado, Greene, Lyle, Lautar and Gaydosh all stayed. Staff clearly talked to guys early. Honestly this is the best portal result we could've hoped for after a title. Losing five is not a crisis when you're 16-0.

posts.name: Nebraska Nate
posts.text: Congrats Ohio State, you beat us 35-17 and I'm still mad. Enjoy it. Everybody knows the committee gave you the Indiana game, the FSU game, the BYU game, and the draw. We'll see you next year.

posts.name: Worried in Worthington
posts.text: Lost a four-star guard AND a corner AND an edge rusher to the portal and nobody on here is even a little concerned? Tim Coffey was my guy. Not saying it's over, just saying maybe enjoy the parade with one eye open.

posts.name: GoBucks_Gary
posts.thread: Recruiting class ranked 138?? Are we cooked?
posts.text: Class is ranked 138th. ONE HUNDRED THIRTY-EIGHTH. I know it's early and the cycle just started, but I saw that number and nearly dropped my beer. Tell me this is a glitch. Tell me the staff has a plan.

posts.name: Tailgate Tina
posts.text: Brought this to the parade. Security didn't love the poster board. Tuddy_roosevelt didn't see it, but I'm blaming the crowd.

posts.name: Matt in Marion
posts.text: Heard Coach Goh banned the word from the building. I don't know which word. I don't want to know. Whatever you're doing, Tuddy, DON'T STOP.

posts.name: Linda Kowalczyk
posts.text: I'll say it, that BYU game scared me. 28-26 over a No. 12 team is not a blowout and my heart rate said so. Still won, still champs, but can we please win by 20 next year? Just for my blood pressure. Go Bucks!

posts.name: Concession Carl
posts.text: Champions, yes. Also paying $9 for a pretzel like I'm funding the portal myself. Worth it? Yeah. Still wild.

posts.name: RedZoneRumors
posts.thread: K.Bing 'money talk went fine' - what does that mean? (conspiracy thread)
posts.text: Source close to the program says the money talk with Bing 'went fine.' FINE?? Nobody on my timeline says 'fine' unless the number is huge or the number is tiny. I'm saying the staff is hiding something. Or everyone is just happy. Either way I'm watching the portal like it owes me money.

832438366.name: Penn State
factors: 5-7 falls short of what a 3.5-star program expects

clip.headline: Penn State Sheds 10 to the Portal as 5-7 Season Bleeds Into Offseason
clip.dek: Three four-stars are among the departures, while the 137th-ranked recruiting class does little to calm a restless fan base.

posts.name: Happy Valley Heartbreak
posts.text: Lost 50-14 to Indiana. Lost 45-13 to Iowa AT HOME. Ranked 102nd in the country. 102!!! We are a Big Ten program in name only. agerm40 has turned Beaver Stadium into a daycare for other teams' offenses.

posts.name: BlueWhite_Since87
posts.thread: Official Portal Exodus Thread: 10 gone, three of them four-stars. Who's turning out the lights?
posts.text: Pat Mooney. George Nsekhe. Marquez Slaughter. Seven more on top of that. Four of the ten were four- or five-star guys. I've had season tickets since 1987 and I have never seen a roster emptied like this. You can't call it a rebuild when the foundation is walking out the door. Somebody in the AD's office better be taking notes, because the kids sure aren't staying for the vibes.

posts.name: Nittany Nate
posts.text: Pullard stays. Zayas stays. Carver stays. Great! Three guys stayed and TEN left. That's not a win, that's a hostage situation with extra steps. Let's not throw a parade because the fire alarm only took out half the building.

posts.name: Lions Den Larry
posts.text: Paid full price to watch this. Section was a ghost town by the third quarter. The ushers were doing crossword puzzles. #WeAre #WeAreLeaving

posts.name: Linda Kowalczyk
posts.text: I have been going to Penn State games with my husband for over thirty years and I can't remember being this embarrassed. A 45-13 loss to Iowa at home?? Then they scrape out one win at USC and everyone acts like we've turned a corner. We haven't. The portal is open, kids are leaving, and the recruiting class is ranked 137th. Somebody please explain to me what the plan is. Because I paid for parking and a $9 pretzel and I deserve to know.

posts.name: Big Ten Brandon
posts.text: Penn State fans really thought one win at USC meant we were back. Wins at USC, then loses by 32 to Iowa the next week. We are the most emotionally exhausting 5-7 team on earth. Fire the OC. Fire the DC. Fire the punter. Fire everybody.

posts.name: TailgateTed
posts.text: The only thing hotter than this fan base is the price of a beer in Beaver Stadium. $14 for a light beer and a loss. Incredible product.

posts.name: PSU_Truth_Seeker
posts.thread: Anyone else think J. Walker's TV pitch was the only thing this staff did right all year?
posts.text: Four-star edge. Reported $270K. Sources say we sold the TV exposure harder than anyone. Fine, great, Walker signed, good for him. But what exactly is he going to be exposed to? 14-50 blowouts on national TV? We bought a megaphone to show everybody how bad we are. The NIL math in this program makes my head hurt. Nice get though, I guess. Please don't let him leave in the portal next year.

posts.name: Saquon's Cousin's Roommate
posts.text: Hire Saquon as head coach. I don't care if he's retired. I don't care if he has no experience. He can't possibly do worse than 5-7, 3-6 in the Big Ten. Put him on the headset and let's ride.

posts.name: Sideline Sue
posts.text: Made my sign before the UCLA game. Lost 31-25. Made another one after. Same sign. Same sad.

image.text: WE BEAT USC ONCE. ASK FOR A REFUND ON THE REST.

posts.name: Dave Reinholt
posts.text: Look, I get it, everybody wants to burn it down. But we lost by six to a Top 10 UCLA team, and we beat USC on the road. There's something there. Pullard, Zayas and Carver all stayed, and J. Walker signed. Maybe give it a minute before the pitchforks come out. Trust the process. (Go ahead and call me a clown, I can take it.)

posts.name: Iowa Hawkeye Hank
posts.text: Penn State fans in the replies right now: "We're a 3.5-star program!" You're a 3.5-star program ranked 102nd with the 137th-ranked recruiting class. The stars are doing a lot of heavy lifting. Thanks for the 45-13, though.
